simulation_preview_model.details: studio_automation_simulation_engine view (views.py:990) resolves urls to apps.automation:visual_workflow_{simulate,dispatch_test,publish} and outcomes_console, AND pulls canonical_triggers via apps.automation.workflow_trigger_catalog.get_operator_trigger_catalog_for_school AND ready_playbooks via enrich_playbooks_for_template. It returns guidance + canonical trigger payloads but the in-shell pane (canvas) currently renders only the explainer body. The real simulate API exists at apps.automation:visual_workflow_simulate.
simulation_preview_model.gap: No simulation preview UI is wired in the Automation Studio canvas itself — operator must navigate to the subpage AND then to apps.automation:visual_workflow_designer. The cockpit pane shows no projected actions / no record-count / no risk warnings.
simulation_preview_model.honest_deferral: Build a 'simulation preview pane' partial that shows projected actions / risks / would-be-affected-records IF a simulation has been run. When no simulation exists, render honest empty state pointing at apps.automation:visual_workflow_simulate. Do NOT fabricate simulation results.
